def select(message):
    match message:
        case "stop":
            return True
        case _:
            return False


async def use(items, session, output):
    for item in items:
        async with (

            session.get(item) as response,
            session.lock(),
        ):
            with session.sync_lock():
                output.append(response.status)
    for item in items:
        with session.sync_lock():
            output.append(item)
